name: @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react
summary: The DotLottie React player. It supports .lottie and JSON, React 17/18/19, MIT licensing and npm provenance, and its WASM/worker assets can be self-hosted. The React 19 spike loaded both formats from a local WASM file in 58 ms.
gains: Active release line and provenance-signed npm tarball
Canvas rendering with events and worker variant
losses: 481 KB gzip WASM runtime in addition to JS
CSP must allow WebAssembly and worker-src if the worker is used

spike.scenario: 90-frame .lottie and JSON side by side, React 19.2.0, self-hosted WASM, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: Both canvases reached 90 frames. The JS bundle was 356.93 KB / 93.15 KB gzip; the self-hosted WASM is 481 KB gzip separately. No CDN request was made for the runtime.
